pythonFunction.name: list_recent_payments
pythonFunction.description: Returns the raw payment history (ledger) of the authenticated caller's account: transaction id, amount, timestamp, target invoice, card and status. Call this whenever the caller claims they were charged twice, paid twice, or asks for a refund of an overpayment. The tool does NOT tell you which payment is duplicated: you must read the history and propose two transaction ids to refund_duplicate_payment, which re-validates them in code.
